bhāvasindhurbhaktimegho rasavarṣī janākulaḥ | pītābjo nīlapītābho ratibhoktā rasāyanaḥ ||87||
avyaktaḥ svarṇarājīvo vivarṇī sādhudarśanaḥ | amṛtyuḥ mṛtyudo'ruddhaḥ sandhātā mṛtyuvañcakaḥ ||88||
premonmattaḥ kīrtanarttaḥ saṅkīrtanapitā suraḥ | bhaktigrāmaḥ susiddhārthaḥ siddhidaḥ siddhisādhanaḥ ||89||

saṅkalpasiddho vāñchātmā atulaḥ saccharīrabhṛt | ṛḍdhārthaḥ karuṇāpāṅgo nadakṛd bhaktavatsalaḥ ||91||
analyzed: saṅkalpa siddhaḥ vāñchā ātmā atulaḥ sat śarīra bhṛt karuṇā apāṅgaḥ nada kṛt bhakta vatsalaḥ

original: amatsaraḥ parānandaḥ kaupīnī bhaktipoṣakaḥ | akaitavo nāmamālī vegavān pūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ ||92||
mitāśano vivartākṣo vyavasāyā vyavasthitaḥ | ratisthāno rativanaḥ paścāttuṣṭaḥ śamākulaḥ ||93||
kṣobhaṇo virabho mārgo mārgadhṛg vartmadarśakaḥ | nīcāśramī nīcamānī vistāro bījamavyayaḥ ||94||
analyzed: kṣobhaṇaḥ virabhaḥ mārgaḥ mārga dhṛk vartma darśakaḥ nīca āśramī nīca mānī vistāraḥ bījam avyayaḥ

original: mohakāyaḥ sūkṣmagatirmahejyaḥ sattravardhanaḥ | sumukhaḥ svāpano'nādiḥ sukṛt pāpavidāraṇaḥ ||95||
analyzed: moha kāyaḥ sūkṣma gatiḥ mahā ijyaḥ sattra vardhanaḥ sumukhaḥ svāpanaḥ nādiḥ sukṛt pāpa vidāraṇaḥ

original: śrīnivāso gabhīrātmā śṛṅgārakanakādṛtaḥ | gabhīro gahano vedhā sāṅgopāṅgo vṛṣapriyaḥ ||96||
udīrṇarāgo vaicitrī śrīkaraḥ stavanārhakaḥ | aśrucakṣurjalābyaṅga pūrito ratipūrakaḥ ||97||

original: stotrāyaṇaḥ stavādhyakṣaḥ stavanīyaḥ stavākulaḥ | ūrdhvaretaḥ sannivāsaḥ premamūrtiḥ śatānalaḥ ||98||
bhaktabandhurlokabandhuḥ premabandhuḥ śatākulaḥ | satyamedhā śrutidharaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ ||99||
analyzed: bhakta bandhuḥ loka bandhuḥ prema bandhuḥ śata ākulaḥ satya medhā śruti dharaḥ sarva śastra bhṛtām varaḥ

original: bhaktidvāro bhaktigṛhaḥ premāgāro nirodhahā | udghūrṇo ghūrṇitamanā āghūrnitakalevaraḥ ||100||
analyzed: bhaktidvāraḥ bhaktigṛhaḥ premāgāraḥ nirodha hā udghūrṇaḥ ghūrṇita manāḥ āghūrnita kalevaraḥ

original: bhavabhrāntijasandehaḥ premarāśiḥ śucāpahaḥ | kṛpācāryaḥ premasaṅgo vayunaḥ sthirayauvanaḥ ||101||

analyzed: viraktaḥ vigata arātiḥ na apekṣaḥ nārada dṛtaḥ nata sthaḥ dakṣiṇaḥ kṣāmaḥ śaṭha jīva pratārakaḥ

original: nāmapravartako'nartho dharmogurvādipuruṣaḥ | nyagrodho janako jāto vainatyo bhaktipādapaḥ ||104||
analyzed: nāma pravartakaḥ anarthaḥ dharmaḥ guru ādi puruṣaḥ nyagrodhaḥ janakaḥ jātaḥ vainatyaḥ bhakti pādapaḥ

original: ātmamohaḥ premalīdhaḥ ātmabhāvānugo virāṭ | mādhuryavat svātmarato gaurakhyo viprarūpadhṛk ||105||
analyzed: ātma mohaḥ ātma bhāva anugaḥ virāj mādhuryavat sva ātma rataḥ gauḥ ākhyaḥ vipra rūpa dhṛk

original: rādhārūpī mahābhāvī rādhyo rādhanatatparaḥ | gopīnāthātmako'dṛśyaḥ svādhikāraprasādhakaḥ ||106||
analyzed: rādhā rūpī mahā bhāvī rādhyaḥ rādhana tatparaḥ gopīnātha ātmakaḥ udṛśyaḥ sva adhikāra prasādhakaḥ

original: nityāspado nityarūpī nityabhāvaprakāśakaḥ | susthabhāvaścapaladhīḥ svacchago bhaktipoṣakaḥ ||107||
sarvatragastīrthabhūto hṛdisthaḥ kamalāsanaḥ | sarvabhāvānugādhīśaḥ sarvamaṅgalakārakaḥ ||108||
analyzed: sarvatragaḥ tīrtha bhūtaḥ hṛdisthaḥ kamalāsanaḥ sarva bhāva anuga adhīśaḥ sarva maṅgala kārakaḥ

original: ityetatkathitaṃ nityaṃ sāhasraṃ nāmasundaram | golokavāsino viṣṇorgaurarūpasya śārṅginaḥ ||109||
analyzed: iti etat kathitam nityam sāhasram nāma sundaram goloka vāsinaḥ viṣṇoḥ gaura rūpasya śārṅginaḥ

original: idaṃ gaurasahasrākhyām āmayaghnaṃ śucāpaham | premabhaktipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ govindākarṣakaṃ param ||110||
analyzed: idam gaurasahasra ākhyām āmaya ghnam śucā apaham prema bhakti pradam nṛṇām govinda ākarṣakam param

original: prātaḥkāle ca madhyāhne sandhyāyāṃ madhyarātrike | yaḥ paṭhetprayato bhaktyā caitanye labhate ratim ||111||
analyzed: prātar kāle ca madhyāhne sandhyāyām madhyarātrike yaḥ paṭhet prayataḥ bhaktyā caitanye labhate ratim

original: nāmātmako gauradevo yasya cetasi vartate | sa sarvaṃ viṣayaṃ tyaktvā bhāvānando bhaveddhruvam ||112||
analyzed: nāma ātmakaḥ gauradevaḥ yasya cetasi vartate sa sarvam viṣayam tyaktvā bhāva ānandaḥ bhavet dhruvam

original: yasmai kasmai na dātavyam dāne tu bhaktihā bhavet | vinītāya praśāntāya gaurabhaktāya dhīmate ||113||
analyzed: yasmai kasmai na dātavyam dāne tu bhakti hā bhavet vinītāya praśāntāya gaura bhaktāya dhīmate

original: tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyamiti vaiṣṇavaśāsanam ||
analyzed: tasmai deyam tatas grāhyam iti vaiṣṇava śāsanam

original: iti śrīkavikarṇapūraviracitam śrīkṛṣṇacaitanyacandrasya sahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
analyzed: iti śrī kavi karṇapūra viracitam śrī kṛṣṇa caitanya candrasya sahasranāma stotram saṃpūrṇam

original: || parabrahma prātaḥsmaraṇastotram ||
analyzed: para brahma prātaḥsmaraṇa stotram

original: prātaḥ smarāmi hṛdi saṃsphuradātmatatvaṃ saccit sukhaṃ paramahaṃsagatiṃ turīyam | yat svapnajāgasuṣuptimavaiti nityaṃ tat brahma niṣkalamahaṃ na ca bhūtasaṃdhaḥ ||1||
analyzed: prātar smarāmi hṛdi saṃsphurat ātma tatvam saccid sukham paramahaṃsa gatim turīyam yat svapna jāga suṣuptim avaiti nityam tat brahma niṣkalam aham na ca bhūtasaṃdhaḥ

original: prātarbhajāmi manasā vacasāmagamyaṃ vāco vibhānti nikhilā yadanugraheṇa | yaṃ neti neti vacanairnigamā avocaṃ staṃ devadevamajamacyutamāhuragryam ||2||
analyzed: prātar bhajāmi manasā vacasām agamyam vācaḥ vibhānti nikhilāḥ yad anugraheṇa yam na iti na iti vacanaiḥ nigamāḥ avocam stam devadevam ajam acyutam āhuḥ agryam

original: prātarnamāmi tamasaḥ paramarkavarṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ sanātanapadaṃ purūṣottamākhyam | yasminnidaṃ jagadaśeṣamaśeṣamūrtau rajjvāṃ bhujaṃgama iva pratimāsitaṃ vai ||3||
analyzed: prātar namāmi tamasaḥ param arka varṇam pūrṇam sanātana padam purūṣottama ākhyam yasmin idam jagat aśeṣam aśeṣa mūrtau rajjvām bhujaṃgamaḥ iva vai

original: ślokatrayamidaṃ puṇyaṃ lokatrayavibhūṣaṇam | prātaḥ kāle paṭhedyastu sa gacchetparamaṃ padam ||4||
analyzed: śloka trayam idam puṇyam loka traya vibhūṣaṇam prātar kāle paṭhet yaḥ tu sa gacchet paramam padam
